title: Evaluator Version Manifest V1
description: What an evaluator version IS under traigent.content_identity.v1: everything that changes a score. evaluator_version_digest = 'sha256:' + lowercase hex SHA-256(UTF8('traigent.content_identity.evaluator_version.v1') || 0x00 || jcs_v1(EvaluatorVersionManifestV1)). Unkeyed: the manifest carries digests, model ids and version strings only. This spec does not change fp2 or efp2; it only consumes the efp2 digest as code_digest. Reference: traigent_schema.example_identity.compute_evaluator_version_digest. Normative text: docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md section 9. Every string pattern in this file ends with the portable end anchor (?![\s\S]) instead of $: in Python's re (which Python jsonschema uses) $ also matches before a trailing newline, so '^x$' would accept 'x\n' -- a second spelling of one identifier. (?![\s\S]) means end-of-string in both ECMA-262 and Python.

JudgeV1.description: The model that judges, when the evaluator uses one.

provider.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was closed_enum; contract has no enum/const, so the value is not provably content-free

model.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free string): model
model.description: The judge model id as configured. An alias is recorded as given; the model that actually served is observed per trial (ObservedProviderVersionV1).

config_digest.description: jcs_v1 SHA-256 of the judge configuration (prompt/rubric template digests, temperature, max tokens, parser settings) -- for a registered judge, EvaluatorVersionV1.judge_config_digest.

name.description: The repo's canonical metric-name pattern (METRIC_NAME), capped at 128 characters.

code_digest.description: The fp2 efp2 digest of the evaluator code (docs/fingerprints/fp2.md).

config_digest.description: jcs_v1 SHA-256 of the evaluator's BOUND configuration: thresholds, captured parameters, closure-bound values and any other setting that changes a score but is not source text. efp2 covers source only, so without this a model-free evaluator's threshold change would not be a new version. The digest of {} when there is none.

propertyNames.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free object/array): helper_digests

helper_digests.description: Contents of LOCAL helper files the evaluator calls (project source, not third-party packages -- dependency_versions covers those), keyed by a stable name. {} asserts none.

judge.description: The judge model and its configuration; null (explicitly) for a model-free evaluator.

objectives.description: The objective set. MUST be sorted ascending by name with unique names (the reference rejects anything else), so one set has one spelling. Changing any objective's orientation or weight is a new evaluator version.

propertyNames.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free object/array): dependency_versions

additionalProperties.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free string): dependency_versions

dependency_versions.description: Behaviour-affecting dependency versions (e.g. a scoring library, a tokenizer), package -> exact version. {} asserts none.
